description: This file defines the PaneController class, which manages the layout and state of UI panes in a web application, including toggling visibility, handling layout changes, and responding to media queries.

classes.name: PaneController
classes.description: A controller class for managing UI pane layout, visibility, and focus mode in a web application.

methods.name: setCurrentNavPanelWidth
methods.description: Sets the current width of the navigation panel.

methods.name: setCurrentItemsPanelWidth
methods.description: Sets the current width of the items panel.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Removes media query event listeners and performs cleanup.

methods.name: mediumScreenMQHandler
methods.description: Handles changes in media query state to update mobile view status.

methods.name: setPaneLayout
methods.description: Sets the layout of panes based on a given configuration.

methods.name: replacePanes
methods.description: Replaces the current panes with a new set.

methods.name: presentPane
methods.description: Adds a pane to the view if not already present.

methods.name: insertPaneAtIndex
methods.description: Inserts a pane at a specific index.

methods.name: dismissLastPane
methods.description: Removes the last pane from the stack.

methods.name: popToPane
methods.description: Pops panes until the specified pane is active.

methods.name: toggleListPane
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the list pane.

methods.name: toggleNavigationPane
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the navigation pane.

methods.name: isListPaneCollapsed
methods.description: Returns true if the list pane is collapsed.

methods.name: isNavigationPaneCollapsed
methods.description: Returns true if the navigation pane is collapsed.

methods.name: setFocusModeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables focus mode, updating body classes accordingly.
